text:
alex: FYI getting a handful of reports of quota anomalies right after SDK releases last night. looks correlated with sdk-client 2.1.0 canary.

priya: which SDK? ts? py? go?

liam: TS 2.1.0 (fetch-based transport) and Go 1.9 rolled at 02:10 UTC. py is unchanged.

rachel: support: 5 tickets, customers see 'unassigned' in console for quota attribution. finance pinged.

jamie: digging into request logs — upstream shows header present but lowercased: x-route-policy: tenant=beta;quota=5. our proxy lookup is doing a strict map lookup for 'X-Route-Policy'.

alex: ouch. header case shouldn't matter per RFC but our internal proxy lib uses a header map that is case-sensitive. new fetch client lowercases headers by default.

priya: we should be tolerant. options: 1) patch proxy to do case-insensitive lookup (hotfix) 2) ship SDK change to duplicate header with preserved-case as fallback 3) console/alerts to better surface this.

liam: hotfix to proxy is fastest for immediate mitigation. SDK patch is safer long-term but takes release cadence and customer upgrades.

ci-bot: CI note: header-casing integration tests were skipped in last crash-fix pipeline. looks like a test blindspot.

rachel: customers in prod. i'd prefer hotfix now, then SDK duplicates in next minor. please estimate time.

jamie: proxy hotfix: branch + unit tests + canary push ~30-45m. low risk. SDK duplication PR: ~2h dev + standard release + canary adoption.

alex: do the hotfix. also please add a sampled telemetry flag so Console can chart how many requests had header lowercased vs matched. helps prove regression scope.

priya: agreed. i'll gate SDK change behind a feature flag opt-in so we don't surprise proxies that might reject unknown headers.

liam: i'll start the proxy PR now. plan: change header map lookup to normalize header names to lowercase at ingress and be explicit in docs. also add integration test that uses http2 fetch client.

rachel: i'll open customer notices and inform CSMs. link to incident once ops-bot creates it.

jamie: follow-ups (owners):
- eng-platform: add integration tests for header casing + h2 keepalive
- sdks: duplicate-header fallback opt-in (priya/mark/liu)
- console: telemetry tile for header_case_mismatch (data-ops)
- postmortem (jamie)

alex: sample repro (makes it obvious):
```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: proxy.internal
authorization: Bearer abc
x-route-policy: tenant=beta;quota=5
```
If proxy expects X-Route-Policy exact, it will miss this.

liam: PR opened: proxy/normalize-header-lookup. starting canary to proxy-pool v1 in 5m. will monitor quota attribution.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-0431 created for header-casing-quota. assigned: eng-platform, sdks, data-ops.

[30m later]

liam: canary finished. metrics: attributed tokens returned to normal within 3 minutes of canary start. header_case_mismatch telemetry (sampled) dropped from 7% -> 0.6%.

rachel: support updated customers; finance satisfied. no rollback needed.

priya: starting SDK PRs to add optional legacyHeaderMode=true which will send both X-Route-Policy and x-route-policy for 2 minor releases. owners: priya(ts), mark(py), liu(go).

jamie: created postmortem stub. include test gap and release notes to avoid future outages.

alex: thanks team. good fast triage. keep the follow-ups tracked and close incident after postmortem. :thumbsup:
